Change c0349. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. I; 1831 Ch. XVIII.

Context before (unchanged): We had agreed to descend the Rhine in a boat from Strasburgh to Rotterdam, whence we might take shipping for London.

1818 text: During this voyage, we passed by many willowy islands, and saw several beautiful towns. We staid a day at Manheim, and, on the fifth from our departure from Strasburgh, arrived at Mayence.

1831 text: During this voyage, we passed many willowy islands, and saw several beautiful towns. We stayed a day at Manheim, and, on the fifth from our departure from Strasburgh, arrived at Mayence.

Diff: During this voyage, we passed [-by-] many willowy islands, and saw several beautiful towns. We [-staid-] {+stayed+} a day at Manheim, and, on the fifth from our departure from Strasburgh, arrived at Mayence.

Context after (unchanged): The course of the Rhine below Mayence becomes much more picturesque.

result.rationale: Deletes "by" in "passed by many willowy islands" (a trivial syntactic tightening) and modernizes "staid" to "stayed" (orthography). No change in events or meaning.
